title: Nutty Flaky Turkish Avocado Flatbread
description: A sour and flaky Turkish dish featuring avocado hass pulp, perfect for a high-protein friendly meal, this flatbread is a festive and delicious option for any time of day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the Turkish flatbread to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
In a small bowl, mix together the crumbled feta cheese, chopped walnuts, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, sumac, and garlic powder.
Spread the feta cheese mixture evenly over the flatbread, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Mash the ripe avocado and spread it over the feta cheese mixture.
Fold the edges of the flatbread up over the filling to form a crust.
Brush the crust with a little bit of olive oil and sprinkle with sumac.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
